answer: Use a stake-backed proof lane: each new agent locks 20 tokens, receives a random task, and signs its result. Three established peers compare the answer with the task record; a rotating auditor checks a sample before reputation rises. Honest work gets the bond back, but duplicated proofs burn it and freeze linked agents for 12 rounds. A farm of 250 fakes ties up 5,000 tokens and must fund 750 peer checks. An append-only log makes it harder to forge a second identity; in a karst cave, one plume reveals airflow shared by many chambers, just as one caught duplicate can expose a cluster.
